video_title: Boogie - Jaylen Brown to Blazers is Damian Lillard's BEST Roster Ever!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: The Milwaukee Bucks waited too long to trade Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: This is why you have to strike while the iron's hot early.
quotes.quote: This is why teams can't wait. This is why you have to strike while the iron's hot early. This is why you have to strike while it's a mystery that does he want out, does he want to stay, and you try and get as much back as possible. Now they've waited so long. Now they know there's a bad relationship here. Now they know they want him out. On the flip side, they also know that Milwaukee wants to get rid of him. Are they now finally shopping him going into the summer? I don't love just the timetable of how they handle this. If I'm the Heat, I don't even love that offer. There's rumors that they don't like Nikola Jokic's contract and Milwaukee, so they don't want him added.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: The ongoing uncertainty surrounding the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade situation
quotes.excerpt: I think it's just best that it gets done as soon as possible.
quotes.quote: I think it's more so about the situation being dragged out as long as it's been. This has been a situation that's been brewing for a couple seasons now as far as us knowing he's unhappy there, doesn't want to be there. Actually, I take that back. At some point it feels like he doesn't want to be there, then the next week he does want to be. So it's been a lot of back and forth in this situation. I think it's just best that it gets done as soon as possible.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Milwaukee must decide between trading Giannis Antetokounmpo or running it back
quotes.excerpt: We got to sever this thing.
quotes.quote: And what you said, like at this point, there's so much been done from Giannis's camp to Milwaukee's camp. Like we got to sever this thing. But if Milwaukee's going to play hardball and they want to get everything they want out of Giannis, we might be looking into a situation where they might have to run it back or do they lessen their trade offers?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of adding Giannis Antetokounmpo to the Boston Celtics roster
quotes.excerpt: Obviously you add a top-five player in the league to any team, I think it's going to elevate the team.
quotes.quote: Obviously you add a top-five player in the league to any team, I think it's going to elevate the team. But as far as the Celtics, you kind of got used to their playing style as far as it being more guard-oriented. So you add a guy like this that's more of a force on the inside, I think it changes their whole identity as a team. Obviously, adding a guy like Giannis changes your whole play style. This is a big that must have the ball in his hands. He plays multiple positions on the floor. He can play point, he can play the center, he can be a small forward at any point. So I think a talent like that just changes the whole identity of the team. But to answer the question, does it make the Celtics better? Yes, but I also think it makes this team different, which may not be exactly what they're looking for after already coming off a championship.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Strategic roster construction for the Milwaukee Bucks in a potential trade
quotes.excerpt: I don't think offensively, and in the way the game is played today, that would be a good recipe for success.
quotes.quote: I think it's obviously important to keep guys like Hauser and Schirmer, those other guys that can shoot the ball, that can really space the floor if you add a guy like Giannis. Because you have to have those pieces around. You don't want to have a team like I feel like the Heat would be where they could just pack the paint. That's a bunch of non-shooting athletic guys. I don't think offensively, and in the way the game is played today, that would be a good recipe for success. But now if I'm Milwaukee and I get a chance to get Jrue Holiday, I don't know if he meets their timetable right now either, paying a guy 65, 70 million a year. So maybe there'd be a possibility to kind of get him and then get off Jrue Holiday to acquire some young assets and just completely rebuilds. But I like the idea of Jrue Holiday coming to Milwaukee and at least having him be their foundational piece.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating Portland Trail Blazers as a landing spot for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't be mad at the Blazers. I mean, when you think about their roster construction.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't be mad at the Blazers. I mean, when you think about their roster construction. You got Dame coming off injury and from everything I've seen, he's looking like he may be better than he was before he went down. He's looking really good right now. You have a veteran in Jrue Holiday that's very experienced, championship DNA. Has done it many times. And you plug in a guy like Jaylen Brown. You got the big fella, I mean, butcher his name Clingan or whatever it may be. Clingan, yeah. But I think those are good foundational pieces. You add a guy like Jaylen Brown, I think, you know, they're a real threat in the West. They had a pretty decent season, ended up, you know, getting close as far as, you know, making a playoff run. But like I said, you add a talent like Jaylen Brown, I think it elevates Portland.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland's roster depth and potential for a Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: Talent-wise and team-wise, I think the Portland Trail Blazers fit the best.
quotes.quote: Think about it, you got a star in Dame who really put himself on the map this year. Shayden Sharpe, Scoot Henderson, Camara, like there's all these guys that are extremely talented. And you still have the older, like a Jerami Grant that could be thrown in the trade that makes a lot of money that doesn't really fit their style right now. But talent-wise and team-wise, I think the Portland Trail Blazers fit the best. They're already a great team. They have the young assets, they have the young talents. Same with the Houston Rockets. I know, I know Jaylen Brown's from Atlanta and they have some pieces, but like think about it, they could get Jabari Smith, they could get Reed Sheppard. I don't think they're going to move Thompson, but the Rockets have a lot of assets that I think would be interesting for them.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins' assessment of the Portland Trail Blazers' talent level
quotes.excerpt: If Jaylen Brown goes to Portland, this will be the most talented team Damian Lillard has ever had.
quotes.quote: I tell you this, if Jaylen Brown goes to Portland, this will be the most talented team Damian Lillard has ever had in Portland. I'm picking if he gets Jaylen Brown, I think it's the most talented roster he's ever had. Over the him and the Jrue Holiday run? Absolutely. Nick Batum? Absolutely.
